policy: Only the repositories and commits listed under sources may be fetched, only at install time, only the files listed per item, each verified by sha256. Upstream scripts, hooks and plugins are never executed or installed. Installed skills and commands must not fetch anything or call external services at run time.

design.description: Frontend design: taste skills, image-to-code, DESIGN.md references, web interface review, local Playwright checks.

process.description: Engineering lifecycle skills and slash commands (/spec /plan /build /test /constraints /review /webperf /code-simplify /ship), adapted for local use.

behavior.description: Opt-in behavior mode (ponytail: minimal-code 'lazy senior dev'). Changes how the agent writes all code, so it is never part of 'all' and must be named explicitly.

taste-skill.review: All skills/*/SKILL.md read. No hidden unicode, no prompt injection, no exfiltration. skill.sh only prints paths; scripts/*.mjs are README image tools; neither is used. Several skills hotlink picsum.photos / cdn.simpleicons.org, tell the agent to install packages or to generate images: those skills are shipped as reviewed, adapted copies (kind=derived).

web-interface-guidelines.review: command.md read: plain rule list and output format, no URLs, no commands, no hidden unicode. Vendored unchanged.

vercel-agent-skills.review: skills/web-design-guidelines/SKILL.md tells the agent to fetch the rules from the unpinned main branch of web-interface-guidelines on every run (content can change without review). Not installed and not copied; replaced by our own skills/web-design-guidelines with the vendored, pinned rules file.

awesome-design-md.review: All 74 design-md/*/DESIGN.md scanned (hidden unicode, URLs, commands, agent-directed phrasing) and spot-read. 34 files tell the agent to run `npx @google/design.md lint` (unpinned npm code at run time): that line is dropped at install time. opencode.ai and ollama contain curl|sh install pipelines as page content and are excluded. README files are not installed.

playwright-cli.review: npm 0.1.22 gitHead equals the pinned commit; no install scripts in @playwright/cli, playwright or playwright-core at the pinned versions. The CLI checks registry.npmjs.org for updates once a day (disable with NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1). The upstream skill pre-approves Bash(playwright-cli:*) and npx playwright, recommends an unpinned global install, and documents attaching to the user's real browser, cookie/storage export and uploading screenshots to PRs: shipped as a restricted, rewritten derivative (kind=derived).

ponytail.review: All six skills/*/SKILL.md and .opencode/command/*.md read; hooks/, .opencode/plugins/, pi-extension/ and ponytail-mcp/ scanned (no network calls, no telemetry; hooks write mode flag files and inject instructions on every session start). Only the four plain skills are installed unmodified; ponytail-help is adapted (removed marketplace auto-update, global npm install, config for the hooks); ponytail-gain (author's benchmark claims), hooks, plugins, MCP server and agent-specific rule files are not installed.

agent-skills.review: All 25 skills (incl. their references), the 7 top-level references, 4 agents and 9 .claude/commands read. No hidden unicode, no prompt injection, no allowed-tools. Several skills told the agent to install tools, run network audits, use Chrome DevTools MCP via npx @latest, fetch online docs, send artifacts to external model CLIs, or push/deploy without a confirmation gate: shipped as adapted copies (kind=derived, packs/adapt-agent-skills.py); browser-testing-with-devtools and source-driven-development are excluded.
